hypothesis: A terminal reward for completing the question’s requested facts with their own supporting evidence can improve source-grounded completeness and condition binding; validity-only reward cannot distinguish the observed failures.
expected_signal: More complete supported answers on development questions, without increased unsupported conditions/numbers, excessive abstention, execution failures, cost or latency. This preparation measures no such change.

answerable_formula.C: Number of distinct explicitly requested facts correctly answered with support in the candidate’s own cited source spans, divided by the fixed number of requested facts. Paraphrases count; repetitions do not.
answerable_formula.R: 0 when any material asserted fact contradicts its citation, lacks support or transfers a measurement to incompatible conditions; otherwise C. Empty answers and abstentions on answerable questions score0.
answerable_formula.material_assertions: Answer-relevant mechanism, measurement, numeric, baseline and condition assertions; not a count of output list entries. Unsupported-source true values fail the support gate but remain distinct from fabricated values in diagnostics.
answerable_formula.derivations: Allow an explicit correct derivation only when cited operands and their conditions suffice; resolve ambiguous cases before assigning scalar reward.
answerable_formula.missing_judgment: No optimization reward until missing/disputed semantic judgments are resolved; halt the affected rollout group/batch rather than selectively dropping bad-looking answers. A None/unknown result is not a rewarded abstention.

target_gap_formula.R: 1 only after recorded source inspection, correctly scoped missing target, requested useful next query and the SAME all-material-assertion support/condition gate as answerable cases; otherwise0 for a completed policy episode. Fabricated or contradicted partial literature findings also force0 even if the target gap itself is correct.
target_gap_formula.scope: Inspected frozen sources do not establish target result; do not claim absence throughout all papers or reality.
target_gap_formula.reporting: Gap performance separate from answerable supported quality. An always-abstain policy earns0 on every answerable question. Missing next-query details are not equivalent to fabrication.
target_gap_formula.initial_learning_scope: Propose answerable-case learning first; keep gap behavior as a separate nonregression diagnostic. Any later training mixture must be fixed with an always-abstain baseline before optimization. A mixed reward or extra gap passes cannot substitute for supported answering.

failure_attribution.policy: Invalid final submission, repeated errors exhausting the action limit, or failure to supply required gap report by the policy deadline: terminal0. All attempts remain logged.
failure_attribution.external: Uncertain provider outcomes, unavailable infrastructure or corrupt stored artifacts: no correctness label; halt group/batch and retain failure/cost/coverage records. Do not resubmit inference or exclude selectively to inflate reported quality.

not_rewarded: token overlap with a reference answer
a copied true number that answers a different measurement
readiness_gates: Adjudicate requested-fact lists on development questions; quarantine known rubric/derivation ambiguities until resolved. Do not reuse historical strict verdicts as reward scalars.

Construct development-only contrast sets for missing requested facts, clipped citations, wrong measurement, wrong condition/baseline, correct paraphrase/derivation, unsupported target extrapolation and valid versus blanket abstention.

Calibrate on the development-only design partition, then freeze the judge and labels before checking the separate development-only judge-validation partition in judge-validation-plan.json. Every clear critical negative must get0, all complete supported/paraphrased answers1, supported partials their labeled C, valid gaps1 and answerable blanket abstentions0; no unknown judgments on these clear fixtures. This small sentinel gate is not proof of general semantic reliability. Attribute model-assisted labels provisionally and never fill human review fields with them.

Before paid training, document judge/version/labels, critical-error acceptance and false-rejection results, unresolved cases, group reward variance, evidence of successful sampled trajectories, checkpoint identity, corpus revision, decoding, seed, hardware, cost and a stop rule. No numerical reliability claim follows from this24-episode audit.
Develop only on development; keep reserved questions/references/paper snapshots outside reward tuning and training. Once evaluation outputs influence tuning, retire that split.
next_step: Build and source-review the development-only judge calibration cases; do not launch GRPO or change the MuSiQue reward.
decision_rule: Do not optimize this draft. Before any judge calls, freeze calibration/validation cases, adjudicated requested-fact labels and judge identity. Apply the exact development judge-validation gate in judge-validation-plan.json. Any critical false acceptance, incorrect positive/partial/gap/refusal score or unknown judgment fails the gate. Keep failed checks; changed judge/design requires fresh development validation cases, not tuning on the same check. Passing is limited implementation-readiness evidence, not training approval or statistical reliability. Later model evaluation must preserve the separate reserved reader split under separately approved limits.
